plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Computer-Engineering-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 09/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. TOTAL AS PRINTED: applying the map's own printed credit rule (5 credits unless a parenthetical number is printed) to every printed cell, this plan sums to 186 credits, NOT 180: Years 1 and 3 sum to 45 each, Year 2 to 46 (the combined General Chemistry I cell prints '(4)' for the lecture and '(2)' for the lab, 6 in all), and Year 4 to 50 because each Year 4 quarter prints FOUR rows (Autumn's fourth row is blank as printed, so Autumn sums to 13: capstone (3) + 5 + 5; Winter sums to 18 and Spring to 19). The over-180 total is transcribed as printed and disclosed here, never smoothed; the map itself warns 'Most Computer Engineering students do not finish in 4 years (usually 4.5 ~ 5 years)'. Parenthetical exceptions recorded exactly: B CHEM 143 (4) + B CHEM 144 lab (2) folded into one 6-credit combined entry (the map prints them in one cell); B ENGR 494 (3); B CE 495 (3); B CE 496 (4). The two 'CSS 427 Intro to Embedded Systems or Upper Division CSS/EE Elective' cells (Year 4 Autumn and Spring) are recorded as choice slots carrying the printed wording; CSS 427 is also named in a footnote: 'CSS 427 is offered AUT/SPR quarters. Can be taken concurrently with B EE 425'. Combined lecture+lab cells are folded into the lecture entries with the combination on the titles (CSS 142/143 + CSSSKL labs). The map prints CSS 343's title as 'Data Structures, Algorithms, and Discrete Mathematics I' — the same 'I' title it prints for CSS 342 — transcribed as printed. Markers are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the open diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the four-point marker means 'may be fulfilled with Discovery Core'. Competitive-applicant guidance printed on the map (prerequisite GPA 3.4, cumulative GPA 3.4; two of STMATH 126 / PHYS 122 / CSS 143 may be in-progress at application) is disclosed here and not encoded. Per-year printed notes: Year 1 — the calculus series should be complete by end of first year and is the prerequisite for BPHYS 121 and 122 (the map's wording; the plan cells themselves print PHYS 121/122); Year 2 — 200-level math, B WRIT 135 and General Chemistry I can be completed before entry to the major; Year 3 — 'You must be admitted to the major to take 200+ level CSS and EE coursework.'
